title: Migration lock claim and release payload
description: The single-row migration lock as claimed by the api migration runner and read by the T-GOV-04 pull-request check.

holder.description: Identity that claimed the lock: ticket and job or person, for example api#2@release-2026-10.

host.description: Host name of the process that claimed the lock.

pid.description: Process id of the claimant on that host.

claimedAt.description: Database server time of the claim, ISO-8601 in UTC.

command.description: The runner command holding the lock.

targetVersion.description: The version the holder is moving the database towards.
